title: Dashboard: a viewer whose analytics queries are all refused 403 sees a blank canvas under the title (CRM Pipeline Dashboard as a plain member), with no per-widget refusal
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcUoS2G4jgqRskpExS7

Found in the 18.3.0 release-candidate browser walkthrough (wave anchor #27377, card W3-UX), at framework `main` @ `c4c515ad`, Console built in-repo from the same commit.

## Repro (fresh boot)

1. Boot `examples/app-crm` with `--seed-admin`. As admin, invite `member1@example.com` with role `member`. Sign that address up and sign in as the member through the form. Viewport 1440×900.
2. The CRM landing says "Nothing in CRM is available to you yet". The sidebar still offers **Analytics → Pipeline**. Click it.

## Expected

Each widget draws its refusal ("You don't have access to this data"), which is the behaviour #26971 describes for a tile whose dataset the viewer cannot read. Or the dashboard is not offered.

## Actual

The title, the description and **Refresh All** render over an empty canvas. There is no widget frame, no message and no error. The network shows `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query` answering 403, and the page swallows it. The same member gets a proper refusal state on the Opportunities list.

QA-source: #27377 · ux-walkthrough · track 1
